page.overview:
Who is Mozu and Kiwi?

Mozu and Kiwi, also known as the Square Sisters due to their square-like hairstyle, are two women from Water 7 who were part of the Franky Family. They were both very loyal to Franky, going with him everywhere and tending to imitate every pose he made.

They are both allies of the Straw Hat Pirates during the end of the Water 7 and beginning of the Enies Lobby Arc (starting off as minor antagonists in the former). Currently, they jointly manage Blueno's old bar in Water 7.

Although they are not twins, Mozu and Kiwi are identical in all but hair (Mozu's is not as curly as Kiwi's) and eye color (Mozu has a brownish hue while Kiwi's is green). They both have long, pointed noses and get their nickname from having a unique hairstyle shaped in large squares. When they were younger, they wore their hair in afros.

Mozu is the sister with straight-edged hair, a white fur collar, yellow goggles, a bikini top, slacks, and high-heels.
